strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: na-enyocha igbe dị ugbu a megide ndetu mweghachi nke Google (CRL) wee nwalee ọtụtụ isi mmalite ruo mgbe ọ chọtara igbe igodo dị irè, yana nkwado ndabere na mpaghara malitegharịa nke ọrụ Google. Na-agba ọsọ na mgbata ọ bụla ma chọọ ịntanetị (nkeji 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • igbe igbe sitere na netwọkụ: na-ebudata igbe igodo site na ebe nchekwa gọọmentị (GitHub) wee chekwaa ya na /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. chọrọ ịntanetị wee were nkeji 1-3. A na-eji ya mgbe smart fetch dara ma ọ bụ mgbe ejiri aka gbanwere igbe ahụ.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP nchoputa: na-enyocha modul Ndozi igodo dị anya, na-enyocha ụdị akwụkwọ ikike TEE, wee gosi steeti ngwaọrụ KmInstallKeybox. Agbanweghị ihe ọ bụla - nlele ọkwa ngwaọrụ nkịtị.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): shows Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Modifies nothing at all.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Akwụkwọ ntuziaka RKP ndozi: na-agba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh akwụkwọ ntuziaka. Na-edozi nsogbu akaebe mgbe ngafe akpaka dara. Ọsọ ọ bụla na-ebipụta ahịrị ịga nke ọma/ọdịda doro anya.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: na-agba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh zuru. Na-edozi ikpe ndị siri ike ma na-ewe ogologo oge. Nsonaazụ doro anya na-egosi na njedebe.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: clears Play Store and Google services (GMS+GSF) data and reboots the device automatically. For stubborn attestation only — it never touches your photos or files.
strings.mdCertify: • Asambodo egwuregwu: na-elele ọkwa asambodo RKP nke ngwaọrụ ahụ wee tọgharịa njirimara nrịbama ma ọ dị mkpa. Anaghị emetụ data onye ọrụ aka.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER repair: fixes Google services framework (SOTER) issues related to device attestation. Used for some devices that rely on SOTER instead of Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Tinye PIF: na-agba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Na-etinye akara mkpisiaka ahọpụtara (mpaghara/elu) wee kwalite faịlụ pif.prop/pif.json. Nsonaazụ doro anya na-egosi na ndekọ.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: shows the installed engine state, the fingerprint files (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), and the logs. Check only — it modifies nothing.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: na-agba sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Na-ewepụta ntọhapụ Canary Engine kachasị ọhụrụ iji hụ na ndakọrịta na asambodo RKP amanyere iwu (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Modul ahụ na-ejikwa oghere igbe igbe abụọ: nke mbụ (dị nsọ, ehichapụghị) na nke abụọ (ndabere). Nke a taabụ na-egosi nke oghere na-arụ ọrụ, gbanwee mmasị, ma ọ bụ na-akwalite nke abụọ na isi na arịrịọ doro anya - na nkwado ndabere na mpaghara ndekọ zuru ezu.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Nchọpụta nke iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe: na-enyocha mbubata igodo TEE, ntụtụ ọba akwụkwọ n'ime keystore2, ọkwa nwepụ (CRL), mkpuchi-ndesịta nchedo yana steeti RKP. Read-only — ọ dịghị agbanwe agbanwe.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:

• A na-ewughachi ndepụta nchedo site na ngwa ọ bụla arụnyere.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The actictive keybox is re-applied.
•Google Play# ọrụ na-amaliteghachi na isi.#00006# A naghị emetụ igbe igodo.

Ga n'ihu?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Oghere igbe igbe: na-egosi ọnọdụ nke oghere praịmarị na nke abụọ wee gbanwee mmasị n'etiti ha. A na-echekwa isi (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) mgbe niile, ọ dịghịkwa ehichapụ ya. Ịkwalite secondary to primary chọrọ nkwenye doro anya.

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml na-aghọ ọdịnaya bụ isi oghere.
• A na-echekwa isi ihe dị ugbu a dị ka ndabere tupu dochie ya.
